description: Five English public engineering queries over pre-chunked text, using actual Qdrant Local cosine/sparse/RRF retrieval and deterministic lexical overlap reranking. Same candidate pool for both variants. Not production neural embeddings/cross-encoder or multilingual semantic evaluation.
provenance: Self-authored public corpus and independent relevance IDs. No fixed rankings supplied. Algorithmic token counts are computed from input text only; no gold labels enter indexing or reranking. No downloads, network, provider calls, application DB or .env.
